maddeler.e:
تعاضدت (form VI)
# تَعَاضَدْتُ (taʕāḍadtu) /ta.ʕaː.dˤad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# تَعَاضَدْتَ (taʕāḍadta) /ta.ʕaː.dˤad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# تَعَاضَدْتِ (taʕāḍadti) /ta.ʕaː.dˤad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# تَعَاضَدَتْ (taʕāḍadat) /ta.ʕaː.dˤa.dat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
